params.body:
Writers (role `client`) can now open the deliveries relay. A writer takes a read up and moves it through drafting to review. Sending it to the customer (delivered, with its link), calling it missed or cancelling it stays with editors and admins: the relay answers 403 and passes nothing to the site.

A writer names nobody but themselves. Any owner field they send is dropped, so taking a read up or moving it past due makes it theirs, by the same rule that already applied when nobody was named.

Guests are still refused.

Tests: `test/commitments-relay.test.mjs`, 16 pass, including a new test for the writer's path.
params.title: Deliveries relay: writers work a read up to review, editors send it
